source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: votes read from the result report; 1,393 + 789 + 10 = 2,192 agrees with the printed total poll

note: Triennial election of Antrim County Council on the 23 county electoral divisions; nominations received on 20 May 1958, withdrawals to 21 May, and polling on Thursday 5 June 1958 ('Polling to-day', Belfast News-Letter, 5 June 1958, p. 5; 'results ... held ... yesterday', Irish News, 6 June 1958, p. 1). Four divisions were contested: Newtownabbey (two seats), Ballymena, Islandmagee and Randalstown. Party labels were printed only for the Newtownabbey candidates. Contested: Moore 1,393; Webb 789.
